item.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.

item.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

item.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

item.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

item.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

item.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

item.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

item.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

item.title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.

item.title: OpenAI’s Alexander Embiricos is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — days after the launch of Dots
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: OpenAI’s Alexander Embiricos is coming to the AI Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, just days after the launch of Dots. Join this conversation by registering for your pass. Get you pass now to save up to $100 and get a second at 50% off.

item.title: Get hands-on: The full lineup of interactive roundtables at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: From Nvidia and Chime to Obvious Ventures and Anthropic, explore the entire roundtable agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register now to save up to $100 on your pass and get a second pass at 50% off.

item.title: 6 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Save on your pass before doors open
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: In 6 days, 10,000+ people from across the global startup and tech ecosystem will come together at San Francisco’s Moscone West for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. If you’re planning to be one of them, register for your ticket before prices increase at the door. Save up to $100 on your pass, plus 50% on a second of the same type.

item.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

item.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

item.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

item.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

item.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

item.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

item.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

item.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."
